name: 500 Pound Chicken
summary: The 500 Pound Chicken is a goblin’s promised delicacy, brought to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. The gnome wastes no time tasting it.

sections.title: A Goblin's Promise
sections.body: In Tanaris, Dirge gives you the 500 Pound Chicken to carry to Narain Soothfancy. The goblin says he keeps his word, though he cannot imagine why a gnome would want such a meal. Narain soon supplies the answer: he digs into the enormous chicken and calls it the best he has ever tasted.

faq.q: Who gives you the 500 Pound Chicken?
faq.answer: Dirge, a goblin, gives you the 500 Pound Chicken and says he is a goblin of his word.
The chicken is for Narain Soothfancy, a gnome in Tanaris.

faq.q: Why does Narain want a giant chicken?
faq.answer: Narain wants to eat it. He calls it the best chicken he has ever tasted.

faq.q: What happens when Narain gets the chicken?
faq.answer: Narain mashes his fists into the huge chicken, stuffs his face, and praises its taste.

faq.q: Where does the 500 Pound Chicken go?
faq.answer: You take the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
